findings.summary: `self.previous_defs[-1]` now holds a `Line` object that is truthy whenever it has leaves, so the check passes for any previous def (including top-level) and consecutive top-level defs get one blank line instead of two in non-stub mode; it should use `.depth`.
The CHANGES.md entry is under the stable-style list although the feature is gated behind Preview; it belongs in the 'Preview style' section.
`test_nested_class_stub` covers only one case and nothing tests top-level code, so the regression would go undetected.
